# FilterBox (通知滤盒 / 通知濾盒 / フィルターボックス)

Source: {{ site.url }}/ · FilterBox is a notification manager for Android by Ruoxin He (package com.catchingnow.np, Google Play listing "FilterBox Notification Manager"). This file contains a short product overview followed by the English help documents. Each document is also available as its own Markdown file listed in {{ site.url }}/llms.txt.

## Product overview

- Notification history: every notification is saved to an encrypted history on the phone, including notifications that were dismissed and messages that were later deleted or recalled. Search by app, keyword, type or rule, scrub through days on a timeline, restore dismissed notifications, and export to CSV.
- Offline AI filter: scores each notification on the phone and filters spam and ads. Marking a notification as spam or normal teaches it. The AI filter requires Android 10 or later and at least 6 GB of RAM.
- Custom rules: match apps, keywords, times or phone states, then dismiss, mute, snooze, replace the content, change the sound, read aloud, show as an incoming call, tap an action button, open, or send to a webhook.
- Enhancers: Dismissal Recall (an Undo button for 5 seconds after a notification is swiped away), Smart Shh (mutes an app that notifies too fast), Code Copy (a Copy button for verification codes), and Webhook forwarding.
- Analytics: recent and daily charts of which apps notify the most and how much FilterBox has filtered.
- Privacy: history stays on the phone and is never uploaded; the AI filter runs offline; fingerprint and face lock are available; crash reporting can be turned off.
- Requirements: Android 6.0 or later with notification access; no root needed.
- Download: Google Play {{ site.data.site.play }} · APK {{ site.url }}{{ site.data.site.apk }}
